title: Source registry record, v1 (DRAFT)
description: One record per source, per AD-5 §2.2. STATUS: DRAFT. Phase 3.3-A ships synthetic records only; the real and derived branches are written so that such a record cannot be added without a Gate 3 reference, and they are UNEXERCISED here (authorization §8 item 1). The runtime validates records with cbdc_ingestion/adapters/registry.py and never by loading this file (authorization §7.4); this schema is a review and test artefact, exercised by services/ingestion/tests/test_registry_schema.py (acceptance criterion 3).

source_id.description: Stable for the life of the project and never reused. Lower-case dotted (AD-5 §2.2).

display_name.description: What a user sees as the source, shown with every value (AD-4 §8.1).

provider_id.description: The commercial or institutional provider; null for synthetic and manual sources.

event_types.description: The AD-4 types this source may emit. A source emitting an unlisted type is rejected.

subjects.description: The AD-5 §6.3 subject allowlist, or the string 'open'. A subject is an ordered tuple of components; for fx_rate it is [base, quote, rate_type].

transport.description: Exactly one. The envelope's transport must equal it (AD-4 §6).

endpoint.description: The base URL, or null. HTTPS for every real source, with no credential, query or fragment (AD-4 §2). Null for every record this scope ships.

egress_allowlist.description: The hosts this adapter may contact. Empty for every record this scope ships: egress does not exist and its enforcement is unspecified (authorization §8 item 2).

credential_ref.description: A name a secrets mechanism resolves, NEVER a secret. Null for every record this scope ships, and nothing resolves one (authorization §8 item 3).

gate3_decision_ref.description: The recorded Gate 3 decision. Required and active for every real and derived source; null for synthetic and assumed.

freshness_profile.description: The AD-4 §7 profile, with values from AD-8 §4.2. The ordering invariant is checked by the runtime validator; it is not expressible here.

live_max_age_ms.description: Null means never Live. A synthetic value is labelled Simulated by AD-4 §8.1 rule 4, which precedes the Live rule (authorization §5.4).

plausibility.description: AD-5 §10 bounds. For a synthetic source the range is the GENERATOR'S declared range, never a market range, so a generator defect is caught rather than displayed (authorization §5.5).

max_relative_jump.description: Relative jump from the subject's current value within one expected_interval_ms. 0.2 is 20%.

ranges.description: Keyed by the event type and the subject components joined by '/'. Bounds are decimal STRINGS: a float would lose the producer's digits (AD-5 §4).

rate_limits.description: Documented provider limits and the self-imposed ceiling (AD-5 §7.4). Null for a synthetic source: there is no provider to limit.

schedule.description: Poll interval or cron expression. Required for poll and scheduled, null otherwise.

timestamp_basis.description: Must equal what the adapter emits (AD-4 §5); checked against describe() at startup.

retention_policy_ref.description: The storage and retention terms permitted for this source (AD-11; a Gate 3 input).

redistribution.description: Whether values may be shown to pilot users, and to whom. A Gate 3 term, enforced at display.

status.description: AD-5 §2.4. Only an active record may start an adapter.

adapter_id.description: The adapter implementation this record selects. Checked against describe().adapter_id at startup; a mismatch is a startup failure, not a warning (acceptance criterion 1).

dedup.description: Deduplication scope. 'within_run' only in this scope: restart-safe deduplication is excluded (authorization §8 item 4, §5.3).

allOf.title: A 'synthetic.' prefix if and only if the class is synthetic (AD-4 §3.2, AD-5 §2.2).
A synthetic source has the synthetic transport, no provider and no Gate 3 reference.
Authorization §6.1's synthetic-only assertions: no outbound reach, checkable from the record alone.
Every real and derived source carries a Gate 3 decision reference. UNEXERCISED here: no such record exists before Gate 3 (authorization §8 item 1).
The poll and scheduled transports require a schedule.
